purpose: Visual layout/ambiguity sanity check before model results; no protocol or threshold changes

observations.observation: Three crops show one light-haired person wearing a light top and white shorts; first crop is a bent pose and visually less informative than the others.
Many people wear very similar white ballet dresses and head decorations. Clothing alone is unlikely to uniquely distinguish these IDs; rejection is acceptable.
Four black-suit wearers have some visible differences: glasses, shirt/tie, short hair and bright hair color. Appearance distinctions may be supported without positional cues.
Matching black/gold outfits and similar light hair are shared by many people; fine hairstyle distinctions need caution under stage lighting.
Similar muted outfits under colored lighting; some GT crops show only a torso or legs. Such views may not resolve hair/face and should not automatically be treated as non-matches.
